name: 实现 KeyManagementService (part 1)
description:
实现 KeyManagementService 服务方法: uploadKey, decryptKey, deleteKey
  - uploadKey: (name: String, publicKey: String, privateKey: String) -> KeyUploadResponse pre=name 非空且长度不超过64字符；publicKey 为合法SSH公钥格式（以ssh-rsa/ssh-ed25519/
  - decryptKey: (id: UUID) -> KeyDecryptResponse pre=id 对应的密钥在ssh_keys表中存在且deleted_at为NULL；加密密钥存储模块中对应密钥的status为a
  - deleteKey: (id: UUID, actor: String) -> void pre=id对应的密钥在ssh_keys表中存在且deleted_at为NULL；environments表中不存在key_id
